_meta.note: CN-PIPL-2021 is offered to tenants that explicitly opt in to China-resident data processing. oyatie's own platform data does NOT flow through cn-pipl-eligible cells. This pack is tenant-opt-in only. Cross-reference: F13 compliance finding (P1) from keystone-bundle-2026-05-20-F13-compliance-r1.json.

retention_rules.rationale: PIPL Article 19 — personal information retention limited to the minimum period necessary to achieve the processing purpose; records of processing activities retained for at least 3 years per regulatory guidance; 5-year cap applied as conservative maximum absent a specific statutory authority for longer retention

PIPL Article 28 sensitive personal information (biometric, religious belief, specifically-designated medical and health data, financial accounts, tracking location, information of persons under 14) requires separate consent and shorter retention with enhanced protection

_pipl_notes.separate_consent_per_article_14: PIPL Article 14 requires separate, individual consent for each processing purpose; bundled consent is prohibited
_pipl_notes.withdrawal_per_article_15: PIPL Article 15 requires the data controller to provide a convenient mechanism for consent withdrawal; withdrawal must not be harder than consent collection
_pipl_notes.consent_renewal_rationale: CAC guidance recommends consent renewal at least annually for ongoing processing; this pack requires renewal at 12-month intervals

cross-border-data-transfer.rationale: PIPL Article 38 + CAC Measures on Security Assessment for Cross-Border Data Transfer 2022: cross-border transfer of personal information requires one of: (1) CAC security assessment completed and passed, (2) personal information protection certification obtained from a CAC-accredited institution, OR (3) standard contract (standard contractual clauses) filed with the provincial CAC office. All three pathways require separate per-transfer attestation stored in the audit chain.

ml-training-cross-tenant.rationale: PIPL Article 13 + Article 14: no model training on personal information across tenant boundaries without explicit separate consent for ML-training purpose from each data subject

minor-data-cross-tenant.rationale: PIPL Article 31 + CAC Regulations on the Protection of Minors in Cyberspace (effective 2024-01-01): personal information of persons under 14 cannot be shared across tenant boundaries under any circumstances

_pipl_cross_border_pathways.cac_security_assessment_completed: Required for CIIOs, processors above CAC volume threshold, or transfers of sensitive PI; filed with CAC at cac.gov.cn
_pipl_cross_border_pathways.standard_contractual_clauses_filed: CAC Standard Contract for Cross-Border Transfer of Personal Information (March 2023); filed with provincial CAC office within 10 business days of execution
_pipl_cross_border_pathways.personal_information_protection_certific: Certification by a CAC-accredited institution (e.g., CCRC — China Cybersecurity Review Technology and Certification Center)
